en: A vintage monochrome postcard showing a large ornate fountain in a city park. The fountain has a central sculptural group of several robed figures beneath a domed canopy, with numerous water jets arching outward into a circular basin surrounded by statues of children or cherubs. Trees and landscaped greenery fill the background, and a few people in early-20th‑century clothing stand around the basin. The captions printed in the lower margin read "GRAZ." on the left and "BRUNNEN IM STADTPARK." on the right.
